name: CopyWell
subtitle: Clipboard, screenshots & video
promotionalText: New: mark up screenshots with arrows, boxes, text and blur, and record your screen with your camera and voice. It all stays on your Mac.
description:
CopyWell keeps everything you copy, and now captures your screen too — screenshots you can mark up in seconds and screen recordings with your camera and voice. It lives in the menu bar, answers to the keyboard, and keeps it all on your Mac.

CLIPBOARD HISTORY
• Press ⌥⌘V in any app and the palette opens right where you are. Pick a clip, press Return, and it is back on your clipboard.
• Search everything you have copied — text, links, and even the words inside images.
• Pin the things you reuse to Pinboards, queue several clips in the Paste Stack, and paste them one after another.
• Rich text keeps its formatting; paste as plain text when you want it gone.

SCREENSHOTS WITH MARKUP
• ⇧⌘9 freezes the screen. Drag across any area, move and resize it by its handles.
• Mark it up with arrows, lines, boxes, ellipses, a highlighter, text and blur for anything private.
• Press Return and the picture is on your clipboard and in your history. Save it as a PNG, or copy the text in it.

SCREEN RECORDING
• ⇧⌘0 records an area, the whole screen, one window or one app.
• Show yourself in a round camera bubble, record your voice and the Mac's sound.
• Every click lights up; draw on the screen as you talk. Pause, start over or delete with one click.
• Recordings are saved to Movies ▸ CopyWell, copied as a file ready to paste into a chat, and listed in the app, where you can trim them and share them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Copies that password managers mark as secret are never recorded, and neither is anything shaped like a key or a card number.
• Items you mark sensitive are encrypted with a key in your login keychain.
• No account, no analytics. Optional iCloud sync uses your own private iCloud database.
• The clipboard needs no permissions. Screen Recording, the camera and the microphone are asked for only when you first use the features that need them.

ALSO
• Right-click ▸ Services and a Finder extension to save selections and files.
• Seven themes, five text sizes, 45 languages you can switch while the app runs.
• Every global shortcut can be changed.

CopyWell is free to try for 30 days with every feature unlocked. After that, CopyWell Pro — monthly or yearly — keeps it working. Without a subscription the app locks, but nothing you saved is deleted.

whatsNew:
Version 1.1 adds screen capture.

• Screenshots with markup — ⇧⌘9, drag across any area, add arrows, boxes, text, highlighter and blur, and press Return to copy.
• Screen recording — ⇧⌘0 records an area, the whole screen, a window or an app, with your camera in a bubble, your voice, visible clicks, drawing, pause and start over.
• Recordings — every recording in one place, with trimming and sharing.
• Now in 45 languages, including Bangla, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Slovenian, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu.
• Many fixes: nothing you copy is mistaken for a password any more, iCloud sync keeps the order of your history, images keep their full Retina resolution.
